name: Session Orchestrator
description: Coordinate real PI-Desktop worker sessions by durable Session ID with bounded parallel supervision and reusable child context.

en.name: Session Orchestrator
en.description: Create real durable PI-Desktop worker sessions addressed by their original Session IDs, reuse child context across follow-up prompts, supervise bounded feedback rounds, and record Parent acceptance from final reports.
en.safetyNotes: This high-risk tool can create and prompt durable PI-Desktop sessions through the reviewed desktop.control gateway. Workers inherit the parent project, model, thinking level and permission mode; the plugin refuses to prompt a worker when the host cannot prove that permission inheritance was preserved. It never calls localhost MCP, reads an MCP token, copies the parent transcript, deletes sessions, or loads remote code. Native host permission confirmations remain in force. A Parent can address only its own recorded Worker Session IDs.

zh-CN.name: Session Orchestrator 会话编排器
zh-CN.description: 让 Agent 使用 Worker 原本的持久化 Session ID 跨会话通信，复用子代理上下文，进行并行多轮督导，并在最终报告通过后记录 Parent 验收。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 这是一个高风险 Agent 工具，会通过经过审查的 desktop.control 创建并提示持久化 PI-Desktop Session。Worker 继承 Parent 的项目、模型、思考级别和权限模式；如果宿主无法证明权限继承成功，插件会拒绝提示 Worker。插件不会调用 localhost MCP、读取 MCP token、复制 Parent transcript、删除 Session 或加载远程代码；宿主原有的权限确认继续生效。Parent 只能通过原本的 Session ID 控制自己创建并持久化记录的 Worker。

author: PI-Desktop
changelog: Release 0.3.0: uses the original durable Session ID as the only canonical Worker identity, keeps follow-up messages in the same child context, migrates 0.2.x relationship settings, and bounds lightweight status polling so wait and the Agents panel cannot hang on repeated report reads.
safetyNotes: Creates and prompts durable PI-Desktop sessions through desktop.control. Parent/worker relationships, supervision rounds and explicit acceptance markers are private plugin state; worker transcripts remain in the normal host session store. The plugin uses no network or MCP token and never deletes worker sessions. A Parent may address only its own recorded Worker Session IDs.

agentTools.name: SessionTask
agentTools.description: Create and coordinate bounded real PI-Desktop worker sessions by their original durable Session IDs. Reuse the same child context with send, run supervise feedback rounds in parallel, and use bounded status/wait/result calls. Call accept only after the Parent verifies final reports. Workers are parent-scoped, capped, one level deep, and return only final reports.

title.description: Short worker session title for spawn.

sessionId.description: Original durable Session ID of a Worker created by this Parent.

sessionIds.description: Original durable Session IDs for status, wait, supervise or accept.

message.description: Follow-up or supervision feedback for send/supervise.

note.description: Optional Parent acceptance note for accept.

timeoutMs.description: Optional wait timeout in milliseconds; default 25000, maximum 45000.
